entries.title: Psalms 9:1
segments: <<For the Chief Musician; set to Muthlabben. A Psalm of David.>> I will give thanks unto Jehovah with my whole heart; I will show forth all thy marvellous works.

entries.title: Psalms 9:2
segments: I will be glad and exult in thee; I will sing praise to thy name, O thou Most High.

entries.title: Psalms 9:3
segments: When mine enemies turn back, They stumble and perish at thy presence.

entries.title: Psalms 9:4
segments: For thou hast maintained my right and my cause; Thou sittest in the throne judging righteously.

entries.title: Psalms 9:5
segments: Thou hast rebuked the nations, thou hast destroyed the wicked; Thou hast blotted out their name for ever and ever.

entries.title: Psalms 9:6
segments: The enemy are come to an end, they are desolate for ever; And the cities which thou hast overthrown, The very remembrance of them is perished.

entries.title: Psalms 9:7
segments: But Jehovah sitteth [as king] for ever: He hath prepared his throne for judgment;

entries.title: Psalms 9:8
segments: And he will judge the world in righteousness, He will minister judgment to the peoples in uprightness.

entries.title: Psalms 9:9
segments: Jehovah also will be a high tower for the oppressed, A high tower in times of trouble;

entries.title: Psalms 9:10
segments: And they that know thy name will put their trust in thee; For thou, Jehovah, hast not forsaken them that seek thee.

entries.title: Psalms 9:11
segments: Sing praises to Jehovah, who dwelleth in Zion: Declare among the people his doings.

entries.title: Psalms 9:12
segments: For he that maketh inquisition for blood remembereth them; He forgetteth not the cry of the poor.

entries.title: Psalms 9:13
segments: Have mercy upon me, O Jehovah; Behold my affliction [which I suffer] of them that hate me, Thou that liftest me up from the gates of death;

entries.title: Psalms 9:14
segments: That I may show forth all thy praise. In the gates of the daughter of Zion I will rejoice in thy salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 9:15
segments: The nations are sunk down in the pit that they made: In the net which they hid is their own foot taken.

entries.title: Psalms 9:16
segments: Jehovah hath made himself known, he hath executed judgment: The wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. Higgaion. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 9:17
segments: The wicked shall be turned back unto Sheol, Even all the nations that forget God.

entries.title: Psalms 9:18
segments: For the needy shall not alway be forgotten, Nor the expectation of the poor perish for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 9:19
segments: Arise, O Jehovah; let not man prevail: Let the nations be judged in thy sight.

entries.title: Psalms 9:20
segments: Put them in fear, O Jehovah: Let the nations know themselves to be but men. Selah
